def inside_polygon(x,y,poly):
 inside=False
 n=len(poly)
 for i in range(n):
  x1,y1=poly[i]; x2,y2=poly[(i+1)%n]
  if ((y1>y)!=(y2>y)) and x < (x2-x1)*(y-y1)/(y2-y1)+x1: inside=not inside
 return inside
